planRows.censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort
planRows.directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort
planRows.shortDesc: With views of the Caribbean, we’re between Eagle Beach and Palm Beach, 15 minutes from AUA Airport. Access the beach via our private tunnel and enjoy our spacious two-room suites, pools, cabanas, daily activities, bars, and restaurants. We offer a kids’ club, free made-to-order breakfast, and specialty cocktails during our daily evening reception.
planRows.headline: Escape to Eagle Beach
planRows.locationShortDesc: All-suite hotel with stunning views of the Caribbean Sea. Connected to the famous Eagle Beach through a private underground tunnel walkway.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Admire the ocean and white sands view from Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort.  Unwind in one of our signature spacious suites, with a separate living area and private bedroom. The resort has 8800sq ft of flexible Meeting Space, 3000sq ft Spa, Outdoor Pool, Fitness center and Casino
planRows.directionsTo: From Queen Beatrix International Airport - After exiting the airport, at the roundabout, take the third exit into Lloyd G. Smith Boulevard. Continue to drive westbound for about 5.5 miles. At the sixth roundabout, take the third exit and follow the road until the next intersection. Then, turn right into J.E. Irausquin Boulevard. After half a mile, you will find the Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort on your right. From downtown and the cruise port - Follow Lloyd G. Smith Boulevard, northwest bound, for about three miles. At the fifth roundabout, take the third exit and follow the road until the next intersection. Then, turn right into J.E. Irausquin Boulevard. After half a mile, you will find the Embassy Suites by Hilton Aruba Resort on your right.

planRows.shortDesc: Our hotel is in the heart of Bogotá’s financial and commercial district. Shops and eateries are within walking distance, and attractions such as Park 93, Bogotá Botanical Garden, and the Gold Museum are within four miles. Enjoy free made-to-order breakfast and our complimentary evening reception.
planRows.headline: Steps from shopping in La Zona G
planRows.locationShortDesc: We are in the financial and commercial center of Bogota, close to shopping, restaurants, most Embassies and Consulates.
planRows.directionsTo: The Embassy Suites by Hilton Bogotá - Rosales, our hotel near Bogota airport, is just a 25 minute drive from El Dorado International Airport.  From the airport take El Dorado Avenue (26st) 8 miles to 7th Avenue, turn north to 71st Street 4 miles, turn right to 5th Avenue and turn right 70th Street.  Our Bogota Colombia hotel is on the right and you've reached your destination to one of the leading hotels in Bogota Colombia.

planRows.censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Dorado Del Mar Beach Resort
planRows.directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Dorado del Mar Beach Resort
planRows.shortDesc: Our secluded beachfront resort is on Puerto Rico's northern coast, overlooking the Atlantic Ocean. We’re two miles from Manuel Morales Beach, and 21 miles from San Juan. Relax in our lagoon-style pool, and enjoy pickleball, bowling, a driving range, or the casino across the street. Join us for free breakfast and complimentary evening receptions.
planRows.headline: Beachfront leisure on Puerto Rico's coast
planRows.locationShortDesc: We are a beachfront property in Dorado, less than 2 mi. from dwtn with easy access to the San Juan Metropolitan area.
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Reserve transportation to/from airport or a tour of our attractions through our Tour Desk.  Email toursandtransferspr@gmail.com or contact the desk at (787) 796-6125 ext. 3143
planRows.directionsTo:
From the International Airport: Take route 26 to San Juan, make right to Minillas Tunnel and take route 22 towards Bayamon and Dorado.  Pass 2nd toll, take exit 24 (right) to Dorado on SR 693 and make left at fork (6693).  At the end of 6693, make a left at traffic light and a right at next traffic light. Enter Dorado del Mar main entrance and turn right.
From the West Coast:  Take highway 22, take exit 24 to Dorado to SR 693, make left on 693 then follow same directions as above.

planRows.censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton San Juan Hotel & Casino
planRows.directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton San Juan Hotel & Casino
planRows.shortDesc: Isla Verde Beach is two blocks away, and we've got a reserved area with chairs and umbrellas. Relax right here in our resort-style pool, featuring a waterfall and foliage. The airport is about five minutes away. Enjoy free cooked-to-order breakfast, and have a drink at our complimentary Evening Reception.
planRows.headline: Relaxing, open space near Isla Verde Beach
planRows.locationShortDesc: Ideally located in the Isla Verde tourist area, only 1 1/2 block to Isla Verde Beach and 1/3 of a mile from Intl Luis Munoz Marin airport (SJU).
planRows.hotelTeaserText: Located in the heart of Downtown near the Convention Center, Energy Solutions Arena and shopping. Also, we are 30 minutes from all major ski resorts.
planRows.directionsTo: From Airport: Follow the sign for Hwy. 26 ''Oeste'' towards San Juan/Isla Verde (Baldorioty de Castro Expressway), stay in right hand lane, pass under Hwy. 187 and take next right hand turn, hotel parking garage will be visible on your right.  From San Juan: Take RT 26(Baldorioty de Castro) to Carolina. Exit to your right on exit to Piñones (State Rd 187), take first exit to left and first exit to the right. From Isla Verde Avenue: Turn on Ave Los Gobernadores, the hotel is at the end of the street.

planRows.censusName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Santo Domingo
planRows.directoryName: Embassy Suites by Hilton Santo Domingo
planRows.shortDesc: Our hotel is the tallest building in Santo Domingo, rising 27 stories above the heart of the business district in Naco. You'll find a number of dining options within a five-minute walk. The Juan Pablo Duarte Olympic Center and Sambil Santo Domingo shopping mall are both within four kilometers.
planRows.headline: Stay in Santo Domingo's tallest building
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located in the fashionable Westpark Tower, the hotel offers a spectacular view of the city from the lobby and all rooms.
planRows.directionsTo: From Las Americas International Airport: Take Las Americas Highway towards Santo Domingo. Continue onto Expreso Las Americas and take Tunnel Las Americas. Continue onto Las Americas Avenue and cross Juan Bosch Bridge. Continue onto Expreso 27 de Febrero. Exit onto Ave 27 de Febrero, passing by Ministerio de Industria y Comercio (on the right). Turn right onto Ave Tiradentes. Continue five blocks until reaching Gustavo Mejia Ricart street. Hotel is located on the left.
